# PredictionLab

> Quantitative sports forecasting model platform and statistical probability engine. Operated by GoodsandMore Inc. (Canada).

PredictionLab provides sports analytics, statistical forecasts, and transparent historical results. Model estimates are informational research outputs, not guaranteed outcomes.

## Access and interpretation

- Primary Straight-Up (SU) forecasts and completed results are public.
- Prices, lines, score projections, Players, Performance Ladder, Model Performance, and additional research features require an active premium membership.
- Coverage and available model outputs vary by sport.
- The homepage displays existing Straight-Up win-loss records and Accuracy %, calculated from those displayed counts.
- Simulated performance indicators are not actual account returns. ROI, Brier Score, and Log Loss should not be inferred when they are not supplied.
- Canonical site URL: https://predictionlab.io
- Contact: support.predictionlab@gmail.com

- [Home](https://predictionlab.io/): Quantitative sports forecasting model overview

- [NCAAW](https://predictionlab.io/ncaaw-predictions): Women's college basketball forecasts
- [NCAAF](https://predictionlab.io/ncaaf-predictions): College football forecasts
- [WNBA](https://predictionlab.io/wnba-predictions): Women's basketball forecasts
- [Soccer](https://predictionlab.io/soccer-predictions): League-specific forecasts
- [Tennis](https://predictionlab.io/tennis-predictions): Player forecasts
- [UFC](https://predictionlab.io/ufc-predictions): Competition forecasts
- [Golf](https://predictionlab.io/golf-predictions): Tournament forecasts
- [CFL](https://predictionlab.io/cfl-predictions): Canadian football forecasts

- [All sports results](https://predictionlab.io/all-sports-results): Public graded historical results

- [Model Performance](https://predictionlab.io/performance): Premium statistical research
- [Performance Ladder](https://predictionlab.io/ladder): Premium simulated portfolio tracking
- [Players](https://predictionlab.io/player-props): Premium player research
- [Data downloads](https://predictionlab.io/results/downloads): Results exports; premium access is required for protected forecast exports

## Platform disclaimer

PredictionLab is a sports analytics and quantitative data research platform. We do not provide sports betting services or take wagers.
